title: EGS Recursive Fidelity Test (ERFT) — Controlled Recursive-Drift Experiment
honestyBoundary: ERFT V1 is a controlled, falsifiable recursive-fidelity protocol. It does not assume Φ_EGS is correct, does not claim CODATA status, does not prove AGI safety, and does not upgrade Soft Story nesting grammar into unfinished physics. Suite pass = protocol integrity + reproducible fixtures; empirical Φ advantage is a measured outcome that may fail.

preRegisteredHypothesis.claim: If Φ_EGS reduces cumulative recursive fidelity drift vs matched controls, the advantage must appear across domains, mechanisms, decoy constants, and held-out series — without assuming Φ a priori.
win_requires: lower cumulative RFD vs baseline at depth N
survives decoy constants (√2, e, blind ladder)
preRegisteredHypothesis.suite_pass_means: Protocol executed reproducibly with locked arms/mechanisms/metrics — NOT that Φ won.

experiments.interpretation: Identical recursion/evaluator; only c differs. Compare cumulative RFD trajectories — do not crown Φ unless it wins fair.

experiments.title: Blind constant ladder (φ unlabeled at compare time)
experiments.interpretation: If φ repeatedly lands near minimum drift across domains, evidence strengthens; V1 records rank without special-casing.
experiments.honesty: Single-series blind ladder is illustrative; multi-domain aggregation is the real test.

experiments.title: Continuous Drift(c) sweep with train/hold split
experiments.interpretation: Pronounced minimum near φ on held-out kinds would be interesting; absence falsifies the strong claim for this mechanism/fixture set.
experiments.honesty: Sweep minima are fixture-relative; do not promote to CODATA.

experiments.title: Drift slope contrast (power-law RFD ≈ a n^b)
experiments.interpretation: Hypothesis interest is whether φ changes error-accumulation exponent — not only generation-1 RMSE.
experiments.honesty: Power-law fit is a pre-registered summary, not proof of a bounded attractor.
